Install

  1. Download and fully extract the complete archive.
  2. Connect a developer-enabled Meta Quest headset to a Windows PC by USB.
  3. Enable USB debugging and approve the debugging request inside the headset.
  4. Run Install_Project_2088_SD-arm64.bat.
  5. Keep the installer open and launch Project 2088 from Unknown Sources to bridge the remaining file installation.
  6. Wait for the PC installer to finish before disconnecting.
